note: SYNTHETIC ground truth for engine evaluation. subject_ids are the entities the engine must flag.

cases.name: Same serial range sold to two buyers
cases.description: Lake Basin Energy Ltd sold 4,091 tCO2 (Kisumu) to CarbonLink Exchange on 2023-01-26, then sold the identical serial range again 21 days later.

cases.name: Phantom sale (seller never held the credits)
cases.description: Cobalt Carbon Partners (an unregistered trader) sold 2,000 tCO2 of Mekong rice credits it never acquired.

cases.name: Same serial range retired twice
cases.description: Kestrel Logistics retired the same 1,066 tCO2 a second time for a different claim.

cases.name: Retired by an entity that is not the owner
cases.description: A second company retired credits that were already retired by their owner.

cases.name: Credits traded and retired that were never issued
cases.description: 5,000 tCO2 were sold and then retired from a serial range the registry never issued (Kalimantan).

cases.name: Two projects with overlapping polygons
cases.description: Sundarbans Mangrove Restoration (P01) and Sundarbans Blue Carbon Phase II (P09) claim ~85% overlapping mangrove area.

cases.name: Claimed sequestration above the physical ceiling
cases.description: Cusco Highland Agroforestry issued 52,000 tCO2 for 300 ha in 2022 (173 tCO2/ha/yr; the ARR physical ceiling is 40).

cases.name: Wash-trading loop
cases.description: Tidewater Trading -> CarbonLink Exchange -> Aurora Carbon Desk -> Tidewater Trading: the same 8,000 tCO2 circle among three related desks in 3 weeks, price rising 2x.

cases.name: Suspicious price spike
cases.description: 3,000 tCO2 of Kakamega ARR credits traded at 12x the project median price.

cases.name: Host country and corporate buyer claim the same tonnes
cases.description: Bangladesh counted the same 3,725 tCO2 toward its NDC while Northwind Energy retired them for its own claim (no corresponding adjustment).

cases.name: Greenwashing claim
cases.description: Meridian Airways publicly claims 350,000 tCO2 offset but only retired 106,685 tCO2, part of it from credits that fail verification.
